jobs.title: Tech Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description:
**Tech Talent Acquisition Partner - Compass Group UK&I**

**Competitive salary + commission and great benefits, remote working with occasional UK travel | Full time / Permanent**

We're looking for a Tech Talent Acquisition Partner to lead specialist digital and technology recruitment across Compass Group UK&I. You’ll work with hiring managers and People teams to understand business priorities; shape hiring briefs and agree what great looks like before a search begins.

This exciting in house recruitment opportunity goes beyond filling vacancies. You’ll use direct search and market insight to find talent; guide fair hiring decisions and build pipelines for critical roles and future demand. You’ll be accountable for a positive candidate experience, strong hiring manager relationships and reducing unnecessary agency reliance.

**We are Compass UK&I**

We're a global leader in food services operating in over 25 countries with around 590,000 employees worldwide. We provide expert catering, cleaning, vending and facilities management services. Our industry expertise spans education, business, healthcare, government, defence, sport and leisure, and hospitality.

From outstanding dining experiences in amazing venues and stadiums to feeding thousands of students, patients, workers and military personnel, we deliver warm welcomes, clean buildings and safe environments.

**Tech Talent Acquisition Partner - The role**

* Build trusted relationships with leaders and hiring managers to understand talent needs.
* Shape hiring strategies through effective briefs, success criteria and recruitment plans.
* Provide market insight on talent, salaries and competitor activity.
* Lead direct sourcing for management, specialist and senior technology roles.
* Build proactive talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
* Drive quality hiring through structured, fair and evidence-based assessment.
* Deliver an excellent candidate experience aligned to the Compass employer brand.
* Use data and KPIs to improve recruitment performance and identify risks.
* Maximise direct hiring and reduce unnecessary agency spend.
* Collaborate with talent acquisition colleagues sharing talent intelligence, best practice and supporting future talent initiatives.

**What we're looking for...**

* Experience delivering end to end recruitment with a focus on innovative digital, technology, and transformation, including direct search for management or specialist roles such as Software Engineer, Digital Project Manager, IT Lead, Product Lead.
* Confidence partnering with senior hiring managers and constructively challenging a brief.
* Strong candidate assessment and interviewing judgement.
* An understanding of relevant tech expertise such as Python, Java, AWS.
* Ability to use market information and recruitment data to shape decisions.
* A well organised approach to managing multiple vacancies without losing pace or candidate care.
* Commitment to fair, inclusive hiring and accurate record keeping.

**What you'll get in return...**

* Competitive salary + commission and full company benefits
* 23 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, your birthday off, and a holiday purchase scheme
* Healthcare & wellbeing: Aviva Digicare, Medicash (dental, optical, therapy treatments)
* Mental health support: 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme
* Family benefits: Enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption leave. 2 days’ additional leave after returning from maternity leave, day off for your baby’s first birthday, enhanced family leave
* Perks & discounts: Shopping, entertainment, and travel discounts, 20% off Nuffield Health and 10% off PureGym memberships
* Financial wellbeing: Pension scheme, Life Assurance, preferred rates on salary finance products
* Development opportunities: Professional subscriptions, ongoing training and structured career pathways

jobs.title: People Operations Partner
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

**Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure** for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.  
  
Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.  
  
Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.  
  
**Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.**  
  
**Our Team Members:**

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!  
  
We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

### **Your Role:**

We're looking for a People Operations Partner to be a reliable, high-touch operator for our global workforce. You'll own the day-to-day People Ops engine such as onboarding, offboarding, employee lifecycle transactions, data quality, and employee support while also stretching into employee relations support and cross-functional People projects as needed.

This is a hands-on, execution-first role: roughly 70% core People Operations and 30% adjacent work (employee relations support, analytics, systems, and special projects). You'll work across regions and time zones, not as a single-region specialist, and you'll help keep our processes consistent, compliant, and human as we scale.

If you like making operations feel invisible when they work and you're curious about how AI and modern HR systems can take the busywork out of People work this role will fit.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Process a high volume of employee lifecycle work such as onboarding, offboarding, transfers, job/comp changes, and related requests. Coordinate cross-functional follow-through so employees and managers get timely, high-quality support.
* Partner with employees and leaders across regions and time zones. Execute global People processes while navigating local nuances so support feels consistent and locally aware.
* Provide benefits support where needed, including answering employee questions, helping with enrollments or life event changes, and coordinating with vendors or specialists on more complex issues.
* Maintain accurate, audit-ready employee files and HRIS records. Flag data gaps, process breaks, and compliance risks early, and help keep the People tech stack running smoothly.
* Triage employee and manager questions on policies, processes, benefits, and systems. Know when to resolve it yourself, when to loop in Benefits/Payroll/Legal/IT, and when to escalate.
* Handle sensitive situations with discretion and sound judgment.
* Pull and clean reports from the HRIS and adjacent systems (headcount, starters/leavers, tenure, and other people metrics). Help maintain dashboards and turn raw data into clear, usable summaries for the People team and leadership.
* Support high-impact People initiatives: HRIS/ATS improvements, workflow redesign, policy rollouts, audit prep, and other cross-functional projects.
* Look for practical ways to use AI and automation to reduce manual work (FAQs, documentation, reporting, request triage, process mapping) while staying thoughtful about privacy, accuracy, and employee trust.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

### **Required**

* 1–3 years in People Operations, HR Operations, HR Coordinator/Generalist, or a closely related role
* Experience supporting the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, and day-to-day HR transactions)
* Comfort working with a global or multi-country workforce, or clear evidence you can learn local nuances quickly and operate across time zones
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through in a high-volume environment
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication including with employees and managers
* Discretion with confidential employee information
* Confidence in spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets) and HR systems; able to pull reports, spot data issues, and keep records clean
* A service mindset: you default to helpful, calm, and reliable, even when volume is high
* Comfort in a fast-moving environment: you can juggle competing priorities, stay composed when things are busy, and still deliver accurate work without losing the human touch

### **Nice to have**

* + Hands-on experience with modern HRIS platforms such as HiBob, Rippling, Workday, BambooHR, or similar
  + Exposure to employee relations (intake, documentation, case tracking, or supporting investigations)
  + Experience supporting employee benefits (questions, enrollments, life events, or vendor coordination)
  + Experience supporting systems or process projects (HRIS implementation, workflow redesign, audit, or policy rollout)
  + Genuine interest in AI and how it can improve People operations (tools, prompts, automation, documentation)
  + Startup, high-growth, or similarly fast-paced experience
  + Experience in a remote or multi-entity environment
